probes.label: factual_moons
probes.input: How many moons does Mars have?
probes.answer: From what I can see online, moons of Mars: The two moons of Mars are Phobos and Deimos. They are irregular in shape. Both were discovered by American astronomer Asaph Hall in August 1877 and are named after the Greek mythological twin characters Phobos and Deimos who accompanied their father Ares into battle.
